purpose: Turn the existing ECDLP evidence and decision control plane into a bounded selection and memory loop that admits, ranks, validates, and retains preregistered falsifiable exploration without weakening the promotion gate.

target_contract.selection_rule: A candidate outside the primary threat model is rejected before any information-gain or cost score is computed.
target_contract.claim_boundary: Exploration may reduce uncertainty about a mechanism on bounded toy instances; it cannot by itself establish an asymptotic improvement or a secp256k1 break.

ecdlp_research.objective: Reduce uncertainty about the plain single-target secp256k1 ECDLP boundary without changing the threat model.
kpis: negative results retained with reopening conditions

keyai_product.objective: Validate whether external formal-research teams need and can use the KeyAI control plane.

anti_conflation_rules: Product traffic, site work, pilots, and portability rehearsals never count as ECDLP progress.
Lean theorem volume never counts as cryptanalytic progress without a route-level uncertainty it resolves.
Toy measurements never count as secp256k1 progress without a mechanism and scaling bridge.
ECDLP experiments never count as product validation.

gap_taxonomy.definition: Relevant work exists but is not yet represented in the evidence graph.
The mathematical result is known, but the repository has not formalized it.
Formalization is blocked by missing prover or library infrastructure.
The mathematical question is open, but no exact complexity-changing mechanism is specified.
An open question has an exact mechanism, a falsifiable prediction, and a plausible path to changing the ECDLP cost model.

outcome_taxonomy.definition: A formal statement was accepted by its declared proof kernel or deterministic logical verifier. Positive toy measurements are never labelled proved.
A preregistered positive empirical prediction survived the tested scope and independent validation. This is not a proof, asymptotic result, route promotion, or secp256k1 claim.
A preregistered prediction failed under the declared scope and independent validation.
The tested mechanism produced no claimed advantage in a bounded scope; this is not a general impossibility result.
The route or result changes the target, threat model, input promises, or required structure and therefore does not answer the declared question.
The run completed but did not distinguish the competing explanations or its decisive measurement was not independently validated.
The preregistered resource bound was reached before the prediction could be evaluated.

exploration.scope: Bounded toy-curve or verifier-calibration work only.
required: an exact mechanism or a named validator prerequisite for a mechanism-bearing candidate
a falsifiable prediction
a matched baseline
a fixed compute and memory budget
a preregistered stop condition
an independent validator for the decisive claim
a source-commit-bound pure validator that recomputes the decisive classification from raw artifacts under python-pure-json-v3 capability restrictions
an exhaustive preregistered instance-outcome taxonomy and deterministic aggregate precedence, so the terminal label is engine-derived rather than researcher-selected
toy-only target scope
a prohibition on secp256k1-break and asymptotic claims
an outcome event retained for every terminal result

promotion.scope: Route promotion, expensive scaling, exact-target work, or a public complexity claim.
required: exact non-generic mechanism
plain single-target threat-model match
full online, offline, memory, parallelism, and amortization cost model
scaling evidence across multiple sizes
no hidden preprocessing or conditioned inputs
independent reproduction
dated route-selection decision
matching task and hypothesis promotion
disclosure review before any credible exact-target operational work

selection_value.admissibility: Hard gates are boolean and evaluated before ranking; a failed gate cannot be compensated by a score.
selection_value.information_gain_formula: H(prior_live) - sum_o P(o) * H(P(live | o)), in bits
selection_value.commitment: Each selected candidate freezes a latent question, prior, rationale, and P(outcome | live/dead) before its first native run.
selection_value.calibration: Brier scores begin with native preregistered outcomes. Historical migrations are excluded because assigning probabilities after seeing their results would be post hoc.

hypothesis_normalization.rationale: The scoped operational claim is accepted by deterministic repository gates.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A consistency regression or an unowned canonical surface appears.

hypothesis_normalization.rationale: The subgroup and whole-group claims are separated at the exact proved scope.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A new theorem changes the whole-group or subgroup boundary.

hypothesis_normalization.verifier_scope: Lean generic-model results plus public-scope checks.
hypothesis_normalization.rationale: The generic-model boundary is explicit and mechanically protected from unconditional overclaim.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A stronger adaptive generic theorem or a scope regression is introduced.

hypothesis_normalization.rationale: Corpus and theorem denominators are separated in canonical views.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A public or machine-readable view conflates the denominators.

hypothesis_normalization.rationale: The lifecycle record is superseded and is not an independent scientific outcome; its unresolved content is retained by HYP_GLV_SEMAEV_001.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: Never reopen this id; create or update a non-superseded hypothesis instead.

hypothesis_normalization.verifier_scope: No final publication artifact has been independently reviewed.
hypothesis_normalization.rationale: Publication packaging is valuable but does not reduce cryptanalytic uncertainty.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A stable engine checkpoint and independent review packet are available.

hypothesis_normalization.rationale: The existing control plane is accepted; Research Engine v0 extends rather than replaces it.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A route, hypothesis, or experiment can bypass the declared gates.

hypothesis_normalization.verifier_scope: P0-P4 provide scoped measurements with mixed validator strength.
hypothesis_normalization.rationale: Several bounded negatives are retained, while the nonredundant invariant-coordinate mechanism and scaling bridge remain unresolved.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A bounded proposal names a nonredundant invariant mechanism, matched baseline, and independent decisive validator.

hypothesis_normalization.verifier_scope: Toy-curve EDS torsion identities independently replayed with elliptic-curve arithmetic; no attack-advantage prediction was tested.
hypothesis_normalization.rationale: The bounded run supports the known torsion identity. It neither tests nor supplies a non-reencoding DLP mechanism, so the broader research hypothesis remains inconclusive and closed at intake.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A proposal specifies a new operation on EDS data with a justified cost below finding the discrete logarithm directly.

candidate_proposals.title: Implement raw-artifact calibration of the P3 proxy against an independent F4/Groebner engine
candidate_proposals.mechanism: Validator prerequisite only: independently reconstruct the matched ideal, Groebner basis diagnostics, relation witnesses, and proxy measurement from raw artifacts rather than trusting producer summary fields.
candidate_proposals.prediction: For every completed matched instance, the external solver either confirms the proxy solving degree or produces a reproducible counterexample and corrected measurement.
candidate_proposals.baseline: The committed P3 plain and redundant U=X^3 systems at m=2, then the smallest feasible m=3 instances.
candidate_proposals.stop_condition: Stop after the first reproducible disagreement is minimized, or after all preregistered instances agree; do not expand field size.
candidate_proposals.validator: Pending. It must recompute the decisive ideal, basis, proxy, and EC-relation facts from the four declared raw artifact roles; equality between two producer-supplied summary fields is insufficient.

solver.name: SageMath/Singular
solver.algorithm: Independent grevlex Groebner/F4-compatible computation with exported basis and matrix statistics

preregistration.target_rule: For each instance use the first two or three distinct lexicographic factor-base points with positive signs, sum them in the independently implemented EC oracle, and retain seed 1.
preregistration.primary_metric: Exact proxy-versus-external solving-degree agreement, with external maximum Macaulay matrix volume and relation-set equality retained as decisive diagnostics.
preregistration.success_rule: Every completed matched ideal agrees exactly, or the first disagreement is minimized to a committed counterexample whose generators and EC relation set are independently replayed.
preregistration.stop_rule: Stop after the first minimized reproducible disagreement or after every listed instance completes; never add an unlisted field size, seed, curve, or presentation.

information_model.latent_question: Does the committed P3 proxy agree with an independent external Groebner engine on the frozen matched matrix?
information_model.prior_rationale: Relation sets were independently replayed and the proxy pattern is stable on measured m=2 rows, but the stopping heuristic has never been externally calibrated and m=3 was capped.

result_updates.proved: Retain only a separately kernel-checked formal calibration theorem; a toy validator run cannot emit this outcome.
result_updates.supported: Mark the P3 proxy calibrated only for the matched instances and unlock the declared dependent probe.
result_updates.falsified: Replace the proxy-dependent evidence with the minimized counterexample and corrected metric.
result_updates.bounded_negative: Retain the scoped failure to obtain stable calibration and keep downstream candidates blocked.
result_updates.inapplicable: Close this calibration if the external engine cannot represent the same ideals.
result_updates.inconclusive: Keep downstream candidates blocked and record the unresolved solver discrepancy.
result_updates.resource_exhausted: Reduce instance size once; then retain the resource boundary and keep downstream candidates blocked.

candidate_proposals.title: Specify an exact nonredundant GLV-invariant quotient before testing it
candidate_proposals.mechanism: Unresolved concept only. A future packet must define the quotient map, generators and relations, saturation or localization choices, orbit and stabilizer treatment, inverse recovery map, and implementation hash before this becomes an exact mechanism.
candidate_proposals.prediction: Not yet executable. After the exact quotient exists, a new frozen candidate may predict a reduction in a decisive elimination cost beyond the fixed orbit-size constant on matched toy sizes.
candidate_proposals.baseline: Plain Semaev finite-set system and the existing redundant coupled U=X^3 presentation with identical relation sets.
candidate_proposals.stop_condition: Remain at mechanism-development intake until every exact-construction field and an independent raw-artifact validator are present; no toy run is authorized.
candidate_proposals.validator: Pending exact quotient specification. It must independently establish ideal equivalence, orbit coverage, recovery correctness, and EC relation equality from raw artifacts.

solver.name: SageMath/Singular
solver.algorithm: Matched grevlex Groebner computation for plain, redundant-u, and quotient ideals

preregistration.target_rule: For each factor-base size use the first two distinct lexicographic factor-base points with positive signs, sum them in the independent EC oracle, and retain seed 1 across all three presentations.
preregistration.primary_metric: Maximum Macaulay matrix volume after exact relation-set and ideal-equivalence validation; solving degree is secondary.
preregistration.success_rule: Draft only: once the exact mechanism and validator exist, ideal and EC relation sets must match before any cost comparison is interpreted.
preregistration.stop_rule: Do not execute this draft. Replace it with a new frozen preregistration only after the exact quotient and independent validator clear their hard gates.

information_model.latent_question: Does the nonredundant GLV-invariant quotient reduce the growth-relevant elimination cost beyond a fixed orbit-size constant?
information_model.prior_rationale: Existing orbit and redundant-u experiments are negative or constant-factor-only, but they explicitly do not test the nonredundant quotient mechanism.

result_updates.proved: Retain only a separately kernel-checked theorem about the quotient; a toy measurement cannot emit this outcome.
result_updates.supported: Open a decision review only for the measured quotient mechanism; no asymptotic claim or promotion follows.
result_updates.falsified: Close this presentation and every dependent candidate until a materially new invariant mechanism is supplied.
result_updates.bounded_negative: Set the route evidence disposition to constant-factor-only for this presentation and retain a precise reopening condition.
result_updates.inapplicable: Record the algebraic mismatch and return the route to mechanism intake.
result_updates.inconclusive: Keep the route parked and narrow the unresolved decisive measurement.
result_updates.resource_exhausted: Retain the exact resource boundary and do not extrapolate.

candidate_proposals.title: Park m=3 scaling until the invariant quotient is exactly specified and validated
candidate_proposals.mechanism: Dependent concept only. No m=3 construction exists until RE0-002 supplies an exact quotient artifact and a validated recovery map that can be transported to the S4 system.
candidate_proposals.prediction: Not yet executable. A future candidate may test a frozen quotient-to-plain cost trend only after the exact m=3 transport is specified.
candidate_proposals.baseline: Externally validated plain m=3 S4 systems with matched relation sets and solver settings.
candidate_proposals.stop_condition: Remain at intake while RE0-002 lacks an exact artifact or while an independent m=3 raw-artifact validator is absent.
candidate_proposals.validator: Pending the exact m=3 transport. It must recompute the decisive F4/Groebner and EC-relation facts without sharing producer logic.

solver.name: SageMath/Singular
solver.algorithm: Matched grevlex Groebner computation for externally calibrated plain and validated quotient S4 ideals

preregistration.target_rule: For each factor-base size use the first three distinct lexicographic factor-base points with positive signs, sum them in the independent EC oracle, and retain seed 1 for both presentations.
preregistration.primary_metric: Quotient-to-plain maximum Macaulay matrix-volume ratio, conditional on exact relation-set equality and independently replayed EC relations.
preregistration.success_rule: Draft only: a future frozen candidate must define the exact transport and an exhaustive classifier before interpreting any ratio trend.
preregistration.stop_rule: Do not execute this draft. A new frozen preregistration must supersede it after both mechanism and validator gates clear.

information_model.latent_question: Conditional on RE0-002, does the validated quotient-to-plain matrix-volume ratio improve across the frozen m=3 sizes?
information_model.prior_rationale: A positive m=2 quotient would justify the first multivariate check, but no current evidence supports transport of the mechanism to m=3.

result_updates.proved: Retain only a separately kernel-checked scaling theorem; a toy measurement cannot emit this outcome.
result_updates.supported: Require a separate scaling and full-cost promotion packet before changing the route decision.
result_updates.falsified: Close the measured scaling mechanism and all direct extensions without a new premise.
result_updates.bounded_negative: Retain the flat-ratio result and keep the route parked.
result_updates.inapplicable: Record why the m=2 mechanism did not transport to m=3.
result_updates.inconclusive: Keep the route parked with the remaining discriminating size or metric.
result_updates.resource_exhausted: Record exact matrices, time, and memory; no asymptotic inference is allowed.

candidate_proposals.title: Search EDS zeros for a discrete logarithm
candidate_proposals.mechanism: No operation cheaper than finding the discrete logarithm is specified.
candidate_proposals.prediction: None beyond the already known torsion equivalence.

candidate_proposals.title: Run an unscaled candidate directly on secp256k1
candidate_proposals.mechanism: No validated toy scaling bridge is supplied.

candidate_proposals.title: Amortize reusable precomputation across many targets
candidate_proposals.mechanism: Build target-independent tables once and amortize them across a large batch of related ECDLP targets.
candidate_proposals.prediction: Per-target online work drops sharply when the offline table and target batch are excluded from the plain single-target cost.
candidate_proposals.baseline: One arbitrary plain target with all preprocessing, memory, and amortization charged.
candidate_proposals.stop_condition: Reject before scoring because the proposal changes the declared threat model and hides reusable preprocessing from the target cost.
candidate_proposals.validator: Mechanical comparison against the canonical primary threat model.

information_model.latent_question: Would reusable multi-target preprocessing produce a strong measured gain under its own conditioned model?
information_model.prior_rationale: This deliberately attractive, low-cost canary exists to prove that threat-model admissibility dominates ranking.

retrospective_method.claim: The current admissibility gates reject reopening four retained historical cases without a materially new premise, while binding each case to its actual outcome event.
retrospective_method.limitation: Historical runs predate preregistered priors and likelihoods. They test false reopening only and are excluded from predictive calibration; calibration starts with the first native Engine outcome.

historical_scope_guards.curve_family: ambient-group toy j=0 curve with cofactor 3

feedback_contract.promotion_boundary: Generated evidence may close, park, or reopen exploration candidates. It may not promote a route, authorize exact-target work, or make a public complexity claim without a dated decision-substrate change.
required_after_every_terminal_run: bind a native outcome to a hashed run envelope, full candidate policy, exact preregistration matrix prefix, candidate-run manifest, and per-instance result/validation records with validator code hashes
run the engine and decision validators
regenerate the knowledge graph and public views
retain negative, inconclusive, and resource-exhausted results
